verified_facts.text: The Sanderling is a beachfront retreat on the Outer Banks.
verified_facts.excerpt: at this beachfront retreat where the location alone makes it an ideal getaway

verified_facts.text: The resort has Outer Banks architecture such as cedar-shake siding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expect Outer Banks architecture like cedar-shake siding

verified_facts.text: Rooms look out over the pool, the Atlantic Ocean and dunes, or sunsets over the Currituck Sound.
verified_facts.excerpt: whether you’re poolside, overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and dunes, or watching breathtaking sunsets over the Currituck Sound

verified_facts.text: Accommodations have sand-colored linen headboards and warm wood floors, with the occasional in-suite fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: think sand-colored linen headboards, warm wood floors, and the occasional in-suite fireplace

verified_facts.text: Accommodations are spread throughout three buildings.
The suites have panoramic views from a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: wake up to panoramic views from your private balcony

verified_facts.text: The Residences are vacation rental homes for up to 16 guests with private beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt: vacation rental homes for up to 16 guests with breathtaking views, private beach access, and exclusive resort amenities

verified_facts.text: Theodosia is the main restaurant, helmed by chef Vivian Howard, with views of the sound.
verified_facts.excerpt: Check out Theodosia, the main restaurant helmed by chef Vivian Howard where locally sourced meat and seafood are as much of a draw as the views of the sound

verified_facts.text: The resort has a full service spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: From Vivian Howard’s restaurant, Theodosia and full service Spa

verified_facts.text: Yoga classes take place on weekend mornings on the Observation Deck overlooking the coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our mindful yoga classes takes place on our serene Observation Deck overlooking the coast

verified_facts.text: A complimentary birdwatching program lends binoculars, guidebooks and journals to spot birds on the ocean, sound and resort grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can borrow binoculars, guidebooks, and journals to spot and document the region’s unique birdlife on the ocean, sound, and resort grounds.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary bikes are available to all resort guests for riding around the resort and the town of Duck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary Bikes available to all resort guests on a first come first served basis

verified_facts.text: Guests can pick up a canvas, paint palette and brushes at the front desk for self-guided coastal painting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stop by the front desk to gather a canvas, paint palette & brushes to interpret the colors and textures of the shoreline

verified_facts.text: The Sanderling Seaside Picnic sets out a curated picnic basket steps from the waves.
verified_facts.excerpt: crashing just steps away, and before you, a perfectly curated picnic basket

verified_facts.text: The resort has oceanside fire pits.
Card and board games such as Scrabble and Backgammon are available in the Beach House Loft.
verified_facts.excerpt: popular card and board games such as Scrabble, Connect 4, Backgammon & more in our Beach House Loft

verified_facts.text: Artists' Weekend runs November 13-15, 2026, with workshops led by Molly Reeder and Claire McCarty.
The Sanderling won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
